newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX complex up on API.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent firmer, NYMEX complex up on API.

text.p: Crude futures prices in Asia were firmer in late afternoon dealings on Thursday, pushed by a firm NYMEX in the wake of API stock data.
March Brent was last traded on SIMEX at $22.75 per barrel, narrowing slightly the spread against March NYMEX, which last traded at $24.46, to $1.71.
March Brent closed up 12 cents at $22.48 in London overnight and NYMEX March was up two cents at $24.24 -- indicating a spread of $1.76.

The firmer tone was attributed to data from the American Petroleum Institute (API), which showed crude stocks fell a surprising 3.4 million barrels in the week ended January 3, to 286 million -- one of the lowest levels in 20 years.
A broker in Singapore said there was current buy orders around $22.50 to support the market, but little in the way of offers, indicating a continued correction was possible.
